name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) California Burger with Fresh Avocado & Swiss
whyItWorks: Ripe avocado adds creamy monounsaturated fat and potassium without irritating lactose. Swiss cheese is naturally low in lactose. Hold raw onions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the California Burger on a toasted bun; ask to hold raw onion slices and tomato.
watchOuts: Angie's burgers are a generous 1/2 pound; eat half if prone to volume discomfort
